headline: Netanyahu vows Israel will strike enemies 'at a moment's notice
dek: Netanyahu, speaking from an IDF base, vowed Israel will not hesitate to strike enemies at a moment's notice: 'Do not test us — you will receive harsher blows than you have suffered to date.' Issued eight days before a tight Israeli election, following his warnings to Iran.
sources: AFP; Netanyahu video statement from an IDF base
fault_line: Real threat to Iran — or a wartime prime minister campaigning?
